question: Calculate the GAAP operating income margin for both AbbVie and Thermo Fisher for fiscal year 2024. Which company has a higher margin?
answer: AbbVie's GAAP operating earnings were $9,137 million on net revenues of $56,334 million, yielding an operating margin of approximately 16.2% (9,137 ÷ 56,334). Thermo Fisher has a higher GAAP operating margin.
